summary: Santander Holdings USA (SHUSA) filed an 8-K providing audited and unaudited financial statements of Webster Financial Corporation in connection with the previously announced acquisition of Webster by Santander. The Transaction Agreement was signed Feb 3, 2026, involving a merger of Webster into a Virginia subsidiary, followed by a share exchange by Banco Santander for all outstanding shares of Webster Virginia common stock. Subsequently, Banco Santander will contribute the Webster Virginia shares to SHUSA, then merge entities. Webster stockholders approved the transaction on May 26, 2026. The deal is an acquisition of a US regional bank (Webster) by Spanish banking giant Santander. The financial statements are being filed to comply with SEC requirements for the transaction. What to watch: regulatory approvals from banking authorities and timing of the bank merger.
